==Background==
"'''Intergalactic Bound'''" is an original song produced by Yunosuke and CircusP featuring Hatsune Miku. It is the official theme song for [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2024 North America]].

This song has exceeded 2 million views on YouTube and 3 million views on bilibili.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured on the following albums:
* ''Intergalactic Bound (single)''
* ''HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 10th Anniversary E.P.''

===Concerts===
This song was featured in the following concerts:
* [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2024 North America|MIKU EXPO 2024 North America]]
* [[Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival 2024]]
* [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2024 EUROPE|MIKU EXPO 2024 EUROPE]]
* [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2024 New Zealand & Australia|MIKU EXPO 2024 New Zealand & Australia]]
* [[Hatsune Miku JAPAN LIVE TOUR 2025 ～BLOOMING～]] (Osaka/Fukuoka/Tokyo, Day 2/Hokkaido)
* [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2025 ASIA|MIKU EXPO 2025 ASIA]]

===Video games===
This song was featured in the following video games:
* ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''
* ''{{IW|crypt-of-the-necrodancer|Crypt of the NecroDancer Wiki|Crypt of the NecroDancer}}'' (DLC)
* ''{{IW|cytus|Cytus II}}'' (Hatsune Miku Collaboration)
* ''{{IW|rift-of-the-necrodancer|Rift of the NecroDancer Wiki|Rift of the NecroDancer}}'' (DLC)
* ''{{IW|maimai||maimai Deluxe CiRCLE PLUS}}''
